show.description: When dreams crash, only courage runs faster. Arjun, once a national sprinting sensation, falls from glory due to betrayal and misfortune. As he cleans the floors of the very academy he once dreamt of ruling, his ex-best friend Karan basks in stolen fame, until fate challenges both again in a race that’s not just about speed, but redemption. Watch Now!
